audit_summary.diagnosis_method: opened flawed-report.png first, then PIL probe (probe_flawed.py) measured bar rectangles, gridline y-positions and legend swatch colors (flawed-probe.json); cross-checked every finding against inputs/source.csv before asserting - no assumed generic errors
audit_summary.findings: 7 confirmed issues (findings.json F1-F7): F1 false title (Q3 highest profit, actually Q4 54>32); F2 false subtitle (revenue continuously rising, actually Q3 128<Q2 135, -5.2% QoQ); F3 swapped legend colors (legend blue=cost/amber=revenue but blue bars carry revenue values, whole chart magnitude inverted); F4 truncated y-axis starting at 100 not 0 (Q1 cost 90 and Q3 cost 96 fall below axis minimum, differences exaggerated); F5 bar heights drawn from 0 baseline but displayed on 100-baseline axis (Q3 blue bar top reads ~173 vs label 128 - geometry itself lied, not just labels); F6 Q3 profit wrong (42 shown, 128-96=32 actual); F7 wrong recommendation (concentrate on Q3 for highest profit; actually Q4 leads revenue+profit+lowest cost-rate)
audit_summary.uncertainties: 3 items kept separate from confirmed errors (U1-U3): color/corner style preferences (aesthetic, not numerical), label numbers themselves (correct - kept), decorative footer text (no OCR sweep performed)
audit_summary.corrections: shared zero baseline 0-200 (ticks 0/50/100/150/200, all 8 bars from y=500); bar height = round(value*1.2px) computed from data not hand-tuned; legend remapped blue=revenue/amber=cost matching values; title/subtitle/conclusion all rewritten to source.csv-traceable statements with unified -5.2% QoQ figure; focus quarter Q4 argued from data (revenue 180 max, profit 54 max, cost-rate 70% min)
audit_summary.bar_verification: verify_bars.py color-scans the final render bar-by-bar: 8/8 bars match value*1.2 within 2px (rounded corners/antialias), evidence bar-verify.json - proves bar heights correspond to values, not just fixed labels
